traits.name: Divine Fervor
traits.text: Whenever the Knight with [Divine Target] Divine Target token becomes the Target of an Attack, that Knight gains +1 [P]. Whenever the Knight with the [Priority Target] Priority Target token becomes the Target of an Attack, that Knight suffers Parasitize 1. The Knight with the [Divine Target] token may perform a [Peril] as a free action to pass the [Divine Target] token to another Knight. If the [Divine Target] token would be discarded or the Knight who has it dies, pass it to the Knight with the most Devotion tokens.

traits.name: Dragonfeast
traits.text: Additional Setup: Add the Your Death Becomes a Dragon's Sacrament Judicium card to the Judicium deck.

traits.name: Panzercolony Life Cycle
traits.text: You can put Armor [Armor] tokens in three places: the Knight Pool (called Field), the Panzerdragon Sheet (called Dragon), and the Primal Remnant BP card (called Remnant). Armor [Armor] tokens in Field and Remnant are independent of both each other and the Panzerdragon, and have their own effects described in other Traits.

traits.name: Panzercolony Migration
traits.text:
Migrate: Move all Armor [Armor] tokens from each location to the next, as shown in the diagram below.
(diagram: Remnant → Field → Dragon → Remnant)

traits.name: Panzercolony Germination
traits.text: Germinate X: Place 1 Armor [Armor] token in the specified location (usually either Field, Dragon, or Remnant).

traits.name: Field of Parasites
traits.text:
End of Second Ability Window: Discard X Knight tokens from the Knight Pool, where X is the number of Armor [Armor] tokens in it.
When you are about to attack the Panzerdragon from its left or right side while adjacent (marked with ! on the diagram), you can declare an Attack against the Field of Parasites instead—represented by the Field of Parasites Trait BP card. If you wound that BP, do not Escalate or place any cards in the Wound Stack. For the purpose of move-like abilities (i.e. Vault), treat spaces occupied by the Panzerdragon miniature as your Target.

traits.name: Primal Remnant
traits.text:
Treat the Primal Remnant Terrain tile as a Monster that never activates and has the Lumbering Basic Ability. It is represented by the Primal Remnant Trait BP card. If you wound that BP, do not Escalate or place any cards in the Wound Stack.
Primal Remnant always moves adjacent to the Panzerdragon after it moves. When Primal Remnant moves through or ends its movement on a Knight or a Terrain tile, they vanish (for Knights, treat it as death).
Iron Apotheosis: A new Panzercolony is born, and the Knights are killed and consumed by the rampaging Panzerswarm. You lose the Clash!

traits.name: Beneath the Shadow of Their Wings
traits.text:
Start of Monster Round: Remnant Move 4.
Remnant Move X: Move the Primal Remnant Terrain tile around the Panzerdragon clockwise. See Monster Diagram.

traits.name: Turn to Rust
traits.text: If your [P] would exceed 9, you die! If attacking, postpone your death until you finish resolving the Attack.

traits.name: Insect Tide
traits.text: End of Knight Round: Pull each Knight 3 spaces toward the Panzerdragon.

vp.name: Ruptured Carapace
vp.text:
Climb: Test Might (8+).
End of Monster Round: If on the VP, test Fortitude (9+). Fail: Displace. Knockdown.
When on a VP, ignore Armor [Armor] tokens.
End of your turn: Gain +1 [P]. Migrate.

traitCards.name: Field of Parasites
traitCards.header: Field of Parasites has the same To Hit as the Panzerdragon and gains +1 [AT] for every Armor [Armor] token in the Knight Pool. Ignore Armor [Armor] tokens on the Panzerdragon.
traitCards.top: OVERPOWER X: Discard up to X Armor [Armor] tokens from the Knight Pool
traitCards.critical: Discard all Armor [Armor] tokens from the Knight Pool. You may perform a Bonus Attack!

traitCards.name: Primal Remnant
traitCards.header: Primal Remnant has the same To Hit as the Panzerdragon and gains +2 [AT] for every Armor [Armor] token on this card. Ignore Armor [Armor] tokens on the Panzerdragon. If there are 7+ [Armor] tokens on this card, perform Iron Apotheosis.
traitCards.top: OVERPOWER X: Discard up to X Armor [Armor] tokens from this card
traitCards.wound: Gain +1 [P]. Perform Signature against the Attacker.
traitCards.critical: Discard all Armor [Armor] tokens from this card. Devote.

traitCards.name: Mortal Retribution
traitCards.text:
When you discard an Armor [Armor] token from the Dragon, Remnant, or Field, place a Generic token on this card.
When there are 8 Generic tokens on this card, a Knight may discard all of them to perform an additional [Combat action].
You cannot place more than 8 tokens on this card.
